purpose: Sign in, register, recover access, or verify identity.

shell.selectionRule: Use PublicShell for an entry route; use AppShell only when authentication is embedded in a persistent workspace.

rationale.Surface: Authentication needs one broad semantic region that can host the brand expression and form without forking controls.
rationale.Input: The route collects a labelled identifier while preserving the shared input contract.
rationale.PasswordInput: Credential entry uses the canonical visibility toggle and native password semantics.
rationale.ActionFooter: Primary submit and recovery actions remain grouped at the end of the task.
